goal: Implement the complete manual venue observation workflow from authorized native operator publication to reliable public viewing, expiry, withdrawal and persistence.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/gym-miniapp on the subsequently accepted CP1 commit. Preserve frozen product baseline, use existing dependencies and reviewed technical contracts.

Implement public venue/current-observation APIs, persistent observation head and historical events; native venue screen with large status words, source/time/validity, explicit empty/error/offline state and no invented venue details.

Implement role-gated native maintenance page for quiet/moderate/busy observation and unknown/paused/withdrawn controls; backend checks current role each write, CAS revision, authenticated actor, safe input and transaction.

Use 900-second TTL at server commit, exact boundary expiry, observedJustNow and 60-second publication intent. Controls do not revive historical observations. Polls/reads/restarts/history cleanup cannot change validity.

Initial/foreground/manual and 60-second foreground refresh with at most one request per resource; hide stops polling, stale responses cannot restore validity. Trusted server time plus monotonic elapsed time; offline restart/time ambiguity is historical only.

Commit observation, audit and idempotency result atomically. Lost responses query same operation, no automatic new key/revision/time. Role revoke versus write ordering remains safe. Successful interactive operator writes maintain session idle semantics; polls do not.

Implement observation-specific 30-day bounded startup/hourly history cleanup with persisted progress/error state; preserve current head, control, revision and TTL. Do not implement other domains' cleanup.
Provide two-client evidence, controlled time and restart/concurrency/failure tests, native state interaction checks. Local scoped commit authorized; reports/cp2 records per-AC status.
out_of_scope: No member verification/pairing/deletion, schedule functions, numeric occupancy, door-access integration, estimates, predictions, payments or new dependencies without security gate.
No production data, deployment, preview/upload/release or editing frozen PRD. Placeholder course/member sections cannot be represented as completed features.
acceptance: AC-B01 venue/O01: unsigned public reader sees same durable published revision/time/source as second independent reader; only operator can publish; no invented counts/contact details.
AC-O02: 899 seconds valid and 900 expired in backend/native logic; GET, polling, cache, restart, unrelated activity and cleanup never renew observation age.
AC-O03: never/unknown/paused/withdrawn/invalid/future data show correct unavailable state; withdrawal never selects older fresh record.

AC-O04/I01: one successful transaction/audit per scope/key/body, changed body conflict, two-writer CAS, lost-response handling, expired intent requires renewed observation, no unauthorized side effects.
AC-O05: foreground/background, offline/restart/clock anomaly and delayed responses do not present untrusted cached data as fresh; failures have usable retry states.
AC-D01/C01 observation: restart preserves state; test/store isolated, store refuses simulation/numeric fields, 30-day cleanup preserves head and is recoverable after failure.
Prior tests remain passing, exact frozen baseline and scoped clean final commit documented; real WeChat/device/store evidence stays explicitly unverified.
evidence_required: RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED; base/final commit, file purposes, command logs/exit codes, per-AC mapping, synthetic data provenance, unverified layers and scope check.
Two independent clients and database restart evidence; actual tested source hashes; UI normal/empty/expired/error/control flows using native code, clearly distinguish VM/tool/device evidence.
stop_conditions: Only CP2; stop and report to commander after completion. Do not begin CP3 before acceptance.
If reliable freshness/transaction/authorization needs changed product semantics, stop affected action and report exact conflict.
Missing venue data/AppID is not a reason to weaken engineering functionality or fabricate real-world success.
